source: APPP / MAFF-JICA — Rice Seed Production Manual (សៀវភៅមគ្គទេសក៍ផលិតកម្មពូជស្រូវ), 2014, Agricultural Productivity Promotion Project in West Tonle Sap, p.10
text: For purifying seed lots that contain foreign material or off-type mixture, a step-by-step method is used: (1) Prepare the bulk seed lot to be cleaned. (2) Place the seed into a porous sack. (3) Submerge the sack of seed into a salt-water (or plain water) container and stir/agitate it so lighter, unwanted material separates out into the water. (4) Skim off and discard the floating debris/chaff. (5) Rinse the cleaned seed thoroughly with clean water (rinsing 2 or more times to remove residual salt), then dry it in the shade before storing or using it for sowing.
